## Key structural findings

- No standalone direction, power, or breeze-toggle codes — physical buttons replay/modify whatever state (speed \+ direction) is currently active (dead-reckoning).  
- Reverse \= forward code with last 6 bits changed 010000 \-\> 100000\. Confirmed across all 10 speed pairs and all 3 breeze pairs.  
- Light, Dim Up/Down, and Timers all appear to be modifier bits layered on the current base state rather than fully independent codes — this needs further confirmation of exactly which base state they attach to in practice (does timer/dim depend on current speed too, or is the "base" fixed to a particular reference state? Original timer/light captures from the first session did NOT match this session's re-captures, suggesting the base state was different at capture time — worth testing this explicitly).  
- Breeze Off is a dedicated code, not derived from the offset formula.
